name: Branches of the Tree
description: While your Rage is active, whenever a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to summon spectral branches around it if you aren't Incapacitated. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus) or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of yourself or in the nearest unoccupied space you can see. After the target teleports, you can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
